name: bitcoinu-block-verifier
description: COINU independent block verifier — re-derives entry freezing, lottery, grouping, scoring, rewards and merkle root from public R2 data + user-chosen Ethereum RPC, byte-exact against the canonical implementation (vendored).
notes: Dependencies are pinned to the exact versions the monorepo root resolves (byte-exact reproduction requirement). No ethers. vendor/ mirrors canonical workers/ files — see VENDOR_SYNC.md; verify with npm run check-vendor-sync.
